text:
Predicates:
RosesOnTV(x) ::: x are roses given out on TV.
OnMondayAt8pm(x) ::: x occurs on Monday at 8 pm.
GivenOutOnTV(x) ::: x are given out on TV.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
Portrays(x, y) ::: x portrays y.
LivesOfRealPeople(y) ::: y portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: the TV show Breaking Bad.

Premises:
∀x (RosesOnTV(x) ∧ GivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8pm(x)) ::: Roses are given out on TV on some Mondays at 8 pm.
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8pm(x)) → OnBachelor(x) ::: Every rose given out on TV on Monday at 8 pm is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x)) → Portrays(x, y) ∧ LivesOfRealPeople(y) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (Portrays(x, y) ∧ LivesOfRealPeople(y)) → RealityTVShow(x) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.

Conclusion:
BreakingBad is a TV show in which roses are given out on Monday at 8 pm.
